I liked the original version better, I think it did a better job of explaining the situation and the reason for this man's disappearance. If you don't want to use one of the old unpopular reality bender cliches maybe go for a different kind of SCP object.

There used to be a stone that was thought to completely erase those who touched it from history but since no one remembered who vanished when they touched it the Foundation had a hard time quantifying its abilities even though they were able to otherwise contain the thing… anyway that idea went down the drain a long time ago but I always felt the effect was a bit chilling.

Anyway, the best part of this entire SCP is that it is an item — a man — defined purely by his absence rather than his presence. It's like the whole world has this missing piece and he is it, the harder we look we can see the outline of this guy but never the guy himself. He's gone. That's creepy and tragic.

Show the evidence, and let the reader draw the conclusions about what's really happening.
